name: hotspot
title: Hotspot
description: Points on a picture that say what is there.
use: A product photo, a screenshot or a floor plan with a few places worth explaining. Each pin is a button placed at --x and --y of the picture, in percent, and opens what a button opens: a popover with popovertarget. Name every pin, and list the same points in the text for a reader who cannot see the picture.

instead.when: One caption is enough for the whole picture

classes.name: hotspot
classes.description: The frame around a picture, as wide as the picture: pins are placed against it

classes.name: hotspot-pin
classes.description: One pin, on a button with an accessible name: a 24px disc of ink with a white rim, whose middle stands at --x and --y. It may hold a number. A ring leaves it now and then, and rests while the pin is under the pointer or has focus

properties.name: --x
properties.description: The pin's place across the picture, in percent from its left edge

properties.name: --y
properties.description: The pin's place down the picture, in percent from its top edge

example: Solid brass, with one joint at the base.
